currentResolution: Known findings corrected. Latest production build, static checks, 89 units and 16 affected desktop/mobile checks passed. logic_errors.issue: Repeated quantity-button clicks during a held persistence lock queue the same absolute target from a stale rendered quantity, silently losing increments/decrements.
logic_errors.requiredCorrection: Preserve relative button intents against canonical transaction state while retaining absolute numeric-input semantics.
logic_errors.parentValidation: RED on compiled original: three increases expected 4/received 2, three decreases expected 1/received 3, mixed relative/absolute expected 3/received 2. Parent rebuilt and verified all three cases GREEN on desktop/mobile; canonical minimum, stock and removed-line boundaries passed unit checks.

logic_errors.issue: A delayed add completion opens the bag after explicit dismissal or client navigation because only controller identity is checked.
logic_errors.requiredCorrection: Invalidate stale overlay-opening callbacks on dismissal/navigation without canceling the accepted cart mutation.
logic_errors.parentValidation: RED on compiled original for Escape, close button, newer quick view, Back, Forward and client-link navigation. Parent rebuilt and verified all six cases GREEN on desktop/mobile with mutation persistence and focus assertions.

suggestions: Extend real-held-lock browser coverage to repeated quantity changes and dismissal/Back before add settlement.
scope: Read-only production source review; no runtime verification claimed by reviewer.

logic_errors.issue: Bag removal still announces and moves focus before its asynchronous transaction commits.
logic_errors.status: Shared post-commit continuation contract and complete consumer audit assigned, including canonical wishlist-removal callbacks and cancellation/teardown tests.

logic_errors.issue: Wishlist notices use captured rendered state before queued canonical transactions commit, so repeated toggles can announce saved while the final wishlist is empty.
logic_errors.status: Dedicated TDD correction and held-lock regressions assigned; final verification pending.
